description:
List videos from a YouTube channel, newest first (1 credit per call).

        To get the next page, call again with the `cursor` this tool returns (recommended:
        every page costs the same, however deep). `offset` still works but is legacy.

        Args:
            channel_id: YouTube channel ID (UCxxxxxx format), handle (@username) or channel
                URL (https://www.youtube.com/@username)
            limit: Number of videos to return (default 10, max 100)
            offset: Number of videos to skip (legacy; leave 0 when passing a cursor)
            include_shorts: Whether to include YouTube Shorts (default false)
            cursor: The cursor returned by the previous page, to get the next one
name: list_channel_videos
title: List channel videos
